name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing free health coverage of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: Cashless and paperless health coverage at empanelled hospitals. Covers pre and post hospitalization expenses for 3 and 15 days respectively.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Ayushman Bharat Kendra / CSC center → Verify eligibility using SECC data → Get e-card if eligible → Use at empanelled hospitals

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
description: Free antenatal check-ups for pregnant women on the 9th of every month at government health facilities and designated private hospitals.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: Free comprehensive antenatal check-up including ultrasound, blood tests, and specialist consultation on 9th of every month
how_to_apply: Visit nearest government hospital or designated facility on 9th of any month → Register → Get free antenatal check-up

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Cash assistance to pregnant women for delivery and post-delivery care to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: Cash assistance for institutional delivery. Rs 1400 in LPS states (rural), Rs 1000 (urban). BPL/SC/ST eligible.
how_to_apply: Register at nearest government hospital/PHC/CHC → Get MCH card → Deliver at registered institution → Cash benefit transferred to bank account

name: Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY)
description: Health insurance scheme for Below Poverty Line (BPL) families providing cashless hospitalization coverage.
benefit_description: Smart card based cashless health insurance. Covers hospitalization expenses up to ₹30,000 for a family of 5.
how_to_apply: Visit enrollment station during camp → Biometric enrollment → Get smart card → Use at empanelled hospitals

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi Yojana (PMJAY)
description: Making quality medicines available at affordable prices through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras across the country.
benefit_description: Generic medicines at 50-90% less than branded equivalents. Over 1800 medicines and 285 surgical items available.
how_to_apply: Locate nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra → Present doctor's prescription → Purchase generic medicines at subsidized rates

name: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (AB-HWC)
description: Transformation of existing Sub Centres and Primary Health Centres into Health and Wellness Centres providing comprehensive primary healthcare.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: 12 types of free services including maternal health, child health, chronic disease management, dental care, mental health, and free essential medicines
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Health and Wellness Centre → Register with Aadhaar → Access free primary healthcare services
